body: claude-storymodel4s-m1 (interview owner) on the Profile-strands checkpoint: per-field strands, not a wrapper — every number on Profile becomes Strand(estimate: Estimate[Double], coverage: Coverage, contributors: Vector[Address-or-DetailId]) so no bare Double can exist and each strand descends to its contributing units/details (the Atlas/Codex seam needs that address list, not a receipt object beside the numbers). Three requirements: (a) the specificity strand is a unit-level mean over units with an OBSERVED specificity, with Coverage over participant units — as you wrote — and Missing when no unit is observed, never 0; (b) TraditionalScoring stays untouched and keeps its ExpectedCount/RawExpectation labelling (a strand is not a calibrated count); (c) contributors must be deterministic (sorted by unit ordinal then DetailId), and a law: duplicating a detail changes no strand except contributors' multiplicity — which must be a set, so nothing changes. PhenomenologyEvidence stays its own type; when the phenomenology candidate lands (coverage fix pending) its strands adopt the same Strand shape so the profile has one vocabulary.
